Lina (sales): hey team — incoming security questionnaire from Acme for the POC. they want SIG + CAIQ answers and a list of evidence artifacts. can someone own intake and timeline?
Ben (security): assigning to security triage, i can take this. Lina, can you drop the CAIQ spreadsheet they sent and the customer contact?
Lina (sales): attaching the PDF they uploaded to the deal and cc'ing contact info: Rachel (Acme) <rachel@acme.com>. POC window: target start 2026-04-12, 4 week eval.
Omar (solutions): quick q: will the POC use our hosted stack or dedicated? affects evidence for logging/KMS.
Lina (sales): hosted, but customer asked about BYOK and log retention — said "preference for BYOK if available".
Ben (security): noted. for hosted POC we need to confirm whether customer will supply keys or accept platform KMS. also need answers for: data retention, encryption in transit & at rest, access controls (SSO/SCIM), vuln scan results.
Kevin (pss): SSO/scim yes — Acme expects SCIM user sync. i've got a draft SCIM doc we can share.
Ben (security): Lina — can you confirm expected retention period? Acme mentioned "30-90 days logs" but not final. i need concrete number to answer SIG rows #4.1 & #4.3.
Lina (sales): asked them now, Rachel says 60 days for logs and will accept our platform KMS for the POC but BYOK is preferred for final.
security-bot: "Ticket #SR-4821 created in security-review-queue (owner: Ben). Due date set: 2026-04-08." :white_check_mark:
Ben (security): thanks. next steps: (1) Lina — upload the CAIQ xlsx to the ticket and paste any customer-sent evidence (SOC certs, network diagrams). (2) Omar/Kevin — plz attach SCIM doc + sample config. (3) i'll fill the SIG answers and list missing artifacts.
Lina (sales): uploaded CAIQ spreadsheet and the SOC2 snapshot. link: https://redwood/drive/Acme-CAIQ-331122.pdf
Omar (solutions): added SCIM draft to the ticket, included config snippet for SAML/SCIM.
Ben (security): filling answers now. ETA for draft responses by EOD tomorrow. i'll flag any high-risk control gaps.
Lina (sales): perfect. can we also include a short summary for the AE and RM to set expectations on deliverables?
Ben (security): will add a 1-paragraph summary and a checklist of evidence items needed from Acme.
Lina (sales): awesome, thanks all. i'll ping Rachel if anything else comes up. :pray:
